newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Femsa given buy rating.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Femsa given buy rating.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co analysts Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari on Friday said they gave Mexican beverage company Fomento Economico Mexicano SA de CV, or Femsa, a buy rating.
-- "We conclude that Femsa is the most compelling beverage play in Latin America, making it our top beverage pick and rating it as our only buy recommendation in the sector," they wrote in a report.
-- "Our price target for the next 12 months is $4.55, which represents an upside of 30.8 percent," they said.
-- The stock was trading on Friday at 27.50 pesos.
